notes: POC owner: eng lead Maya Ortiz (product search team)
Primary dataset: help center + release notes + user event snippets (~120k documents, avg 800 words)
Throughput target: 150k nightly embeddings + 200 QPS realtime queries, peak bursts to 1k QPS for short windows
Latency SLO: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms for topK=10 (search pipeline end-to-end)
Cost sensitivity: high — targeting <$0.01/1k embedding units effective cost; asking tradeoffs for quantized models + dedicated reserved pricing

Model preference: prefer open models (FP16/quantized) but want Redwood's verified performance profiles. Will consider hybrid routing (high-quality model for few queries, smaller model fallback for background tasks).
Vector DB: primary is Postgres+pgvector (current infra), evaluating moving index to Pinecone for lower operational work. Need migration pattern and consistency guarantees for incremental batch jobs.
Batch jobs: nightly enrichment pipeline (ETL -> embed -> upsert) — need guaranteed throughput window (2-3 hours) and predictable cost for embeddings at scale.

Security: SSO via SAML required; must retain audit logs for 12 months for compliance; KMS integration for key management; data residency for EU customers (cannot route embeddings outside eu-west region).
Quote from Maya on call: 'We need predictable performance more than raw lowest cost — unpredictable spikes break our realtime UX.'
Demo takeaways: Redwood Optimize suggestions (batch size 64, prefix cache) reduced per-token cost by ~18% in tests.
